title: POST /check response (Rulebook service -> platform), contract v2.1
description: Deterministic: same input, same output. Rounding: shares floored to whole units; money and percentages rounded to 2 decimals.

shares.description: Final size after every cap. 0 when any severity=block entry is present.

dollar_risk.description: shares x |entry - stop|. 0 when shares is 0.

verdict.description: FITS = tradeable at `shares`. Otherwise the most severe blocking rule. NO_TIMING_CALL: no current timing call (missing, or older than the previous trading day). STOP_PENDING: Rick's stop not set yet. OVERSIZED: manual entries proposing more shares than allowed.

blocks.description: Every rule that fired, most severe first. Empty when FITS with no warnings.

rule_id.description: Rulebook ID, e.g. A-17, D-3, C-1

source_ref.description: Course segment (e.g. M5-L1-S2-V) or PRACTICE-RICK for Practice rules

message.description: One plain sentence for the screen.

size_breakdown.description: A-19 'smallest wins', shown so the trader can see why. computed_shares is the size before blocks (shown even when shares=0). Null only for STOP_PENDING (no stop, nothing to compute).

binding_rules.description: All rules that produced the smallest value. Ties list every one.

risk_pct_used.description: Risk actually applied: risk_pct (or the A-grade value) multiplied by candidate.size_factor

after_pct.description: Heat if this trade is taken at computed_shares

limit_pct.description: Effective limit applied: personal limit in Buy Mode, min(personal, 5) in Wait/Sell

shares_within_limit.description: Present on HEAT_LIMIT: the most shares that fit in the remaining heat, min(computed_shares, floor((limit - current)% x account / risk per share)). The member decides whether to take the smaller size or close something.

severity.description: Engine-computed within Wait/Sell (M4-L4-S2). Null in Buy Mode or when unknown.

engine_data_as_of.description: When the engine's market-facts store (stage, moving averages, earnings dates) was last refreshed, so the screen can show data age.
